description: The ENTSOG System Capacity Map shows the latest European gas infrastructure and capacities, published jointly by the European network of gas transmission operators and Gas Infrastructure Europe. It combines the former System Development and Transmission Capacity maps, first as a combined map in 2024, and presents import and transmission capacity data as of the publication date, storage fill rates and LNG capacities taken from the GIE AGSI and ALSI platforms, and aggregated historical gas demand and supply from the latest Summer and Winter Review Reports. Each edition (2026 dated 19 January 2026, 2025, 2024) comes with an ENTSOG capacity dataset in Excel format, and earlier transmission capacity maps from 2010 onwards give capacities at cross-border points on the primary market. Coverage is Europe. Access: map images and Excel files download from the page, and a printed poster (160 cm by 120 cm) is ordered through a form. Licence and cost: free; the page carries a disclaimer that the data are indicative only and must not be treated as data for commercial use. Caveats: annual snapshots at cross-border points, not real-time flows. It suits gas network flow and supply-security simulation, and complements the ENTSOG Transparency Platform and TYNDP projects catalogued here.
